description: React component for a customizable radio button control with optional tooltips, used within the Superset UI chart controls.

classes.name: RadioButtonOptionObject
classes.description: Interface defining the shape of radio button options with value, label, disabled state, tooltip, and tooltip placement.

classes.name: RadioButtonControlProps
classes.description: Interface for the props accepted by the RadioButtonControl component, including options, current value, and change handler.

methods.name: normalizeOption
methods.description: Converts a RadioButtonOption (array or object) into a RadioButtonOptionObject.

methods.name: RadioButtonControl
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering a group of radio buttons with optional tooltips and accessibility features.
